PancakeSwap is a decentralized exchange operating on the BNB Smart Chain. PancakeSwap uses an automated market maker model for token swaps. PancakeSwap issues the CAKE token as its native token.

Bomb Crypto is a play-to-earn blockchain game built on the Binance Smart Chain. Bomb Crypto uses non-fungible token bomber characters. Bomb Crypto uses the BCOIN token as its in-game currency.
